name: scroll-progress
title: Scroll Progress
description: A thin bar that fills as you scroll the page or any scroll container.

props.name: container
props.description: Scrollable element to track. Defaults to the page.

props.name: smooth
props.description: Smooth the bar with a spring instead of following the scroll exactly.

props.name: className
props.description: Position and size. Defaults to a thin bar fixed to the top of the viewport.
